_comment: repeat probe: identical weights and corpus to mix_scale_3.24b, epoch cap 4 instead of 1, so the run sees 12.98B tokens drawn from the same 3.24B. Read against the fresh-data fit's prediction at 13B (2.360, from L=2.157+0.842/D^0.555 on six points up to 3.24B). That prediction is an EXTRAPOLATION past the largest measured point, and adding the 3.24B point moved E by 0.097 -- 2.6x its own stated error -- so the comparison inherits that looseness. It answers 'is repeating 4x close to fresh data', not 'by exactly how much'.
